input_precision: Identical IEEE float32 input values for both implementations; MoonSRC computes in Double then writes float32; libsamplerate API uses float32. One second per signal, channel zero active, other channels silent.
alignment: A centered unit impulse determines integer output-time lag for each implementation. Both complete boundary supports plus 32 output frames are excluded. Aligned RMS differences describe different kernels, not samplewise compatibility requirements.
timing: Each entry retains three trials by default. MoonSRC timing is CLI process wall time including startup, WAV parsing, table construction, conversion and output. Reference timing is an in-process src_simple call including its internal construction, excluding Python buffers and I/O. These scopes differ; no relative speedup is claimed. Comparable MoonSRC core timings are reported separately by bounded_stream.py.
limitations: No universal quality parity claim; finite signal set and one reference converter setting. Published version is not changed by this script.
